concerns.text: The plan cites 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/community-datasets/cs_restaurants/resolve/main/CSRestaurants/test-00000-of-00001.parquet' as a proxy for Materials Project data. This is a restaurant dataset (Zomato/CS Restaurants), not materials science data. Using this as a structural proxy for Materials Project (crystal structures, formation energy) is scientifically invalid and will produce nonsensical results. The plan explicitly acknowledges this mismatch but fails to provide a valid alternative source for the 'Materials Project' requirement, proposing to 'simulate' it or exclude it. Since FR-001 and US-1 explicitly require data from 'Materials Project, OQMD, and AFLOW', proceeding without a valid Materials Project source (or a formal scope change in the spec) renders the core research question unanswerable as defined.

The plan states: 'The "Materials Project" data will be simulated by merging these two [OQMD/AFLOW] if a verified MP source is absent'. Simulating a distinct dataset (Materials Project) by merging two others (OQMD/AFLOW) does not satisfy the requirement to assess imbalance effects across *three* specific repositories. OQMD and AFLOW have their own specific biases; merging them does not replicate the specific data distribution or imbalance characteristics of the Materials Project. This approach invalidates the comparative analysis intended by the spec.
